$comment: Pieces of the Dungeon Assets Pack by zver.3d (v1.0.0, free for games, credit "zver.3d" asked; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for scripts/art/kit/render_kit.py, from the .glb that scripts/art/kit/zver_to_glb.py builds (art/vendor/zver-dungeon-assets/zver_dungeon_assets.glb: the pack's FBX x 100, so 100 glb units are one FBX unit). The reading area of library rooms, at world scale: unitsPerTile 220 (2.2 FBX units a tile, matched on the barrel: the pack's 1.305-unit barrel is the game's 5/8-tile one at ~2.09), so the table (206 x 440 x 125) fills its 2 x 1 cells (0.94 x 2.0 tiles, 0.57 tall) and the chair (94 x 77 x 160) stands on one cell. The table lies along X (rotZ 90, _x) and along Z (rotZ 0, _z), dressed with the fabric stack (halved by zver_to_glb.py: a pile of pages) and the round candlestick moved onto its top (z 125), pivot its footprint's centre. The chair faces +X / +Z / -X / -Z (rotZ 0 / 270 / 180 / 90: its back points the other way), pivot its cell's centre under the seat (pivotAt: the legs' centre, the back leaning 0.17 tiles past it). sunSide: the X pieces (table_x, chair_px, chair_nx) take the mirrored sun, so the faces the camera sees on them (+X: the px chair's front, the nx chair's back) are lit like the Z pieces' +Z faces; a reading area along X is the mirror image of one along Z.
